name: Coven Casting (Coven)
body:
You can use your spells to bolster the spellcasting of your coven-mates.

Prerequisite(s): Caster level 1st, coven member.

Benefit(s): You may sacrifice a spell as a standard action, losing it as though it was just cast, to channel that energy to a coven-mate. Until the beginning of your next turn, that coven-mate gains a bonus to concentration checks and rolls to penetrate spell resistance equal to the level of the spell you sacrificed. If you sacrificed the same spell they are casting, they may add your caster level to their own for determining the spell’s effects.
